headline: The San Francisco Symphony Plunges Into a New World
snippet: The virtual premiere of Nico Muhly’s “Throughline,” Esa-Pekka Salonen’s first presentation as music director, tests the limits of pandemic music-making.

headline: Chinese-Themed Exhibitions Seek a Broader Audience
snippet: The number and wide dispersal of such shows in the United States reflect that Westerners, and not necessarily Chinese, are the intended patrons.

headline: IBM to Acquire the Weather Company
snippet: The company said it had entered into an agreement to acquire most of the assets of the Weather Company, and its data could be combined with IBM’s Watson.
